missionPremise: Two defects in scorers that DO run (distinct from lane SS-W12's six-rails-with-no-scorer gap): (1) the zoning cell reads 0.00% not-yet for counties Smart Site serves zoning for today; (2) countyCoverageScoreCli.ts writes facet 'land-use' while the rail key is 'landuse', orphaning 19 live rows. Source: _dispatches/2026-08-19_ss-w13_dispatch.md, OPS-16 amendment A-020 ruled 2026-08-19.
completionPredicate: A stranger can (a) name the mechanism for every zoning cell that reads 0.00% and check it at source, (b) see a checked-in control that fails when a scorer writes a facet key no rail can join, and (c) see a stated, evidence-backed disposition for the 19 orphaned rows that does not silently regress the 13 counties currently satisfied on the correctly-keyed 'landuse' rail.
scopeBasis: Correctness of instruments that already run. Excluded: building the six missing rail scorers (SS-W12/SS-W14), re-denominating the zoning rail in production (operator ruling; it moves the Texas launch-gate arithmetic), deleting or merging any existing ledger row (DEV_PROCESS 5.4).

verifiedFindings.label: VERIFIED (instrument defect found in my own first query, published per DEV_PROCESS 1.4)
verifiedFindings.claim: feature_index is unique only WITHIN a county, not across counties.
verifiedFindings.evidence: DISTINCT ON (feature_index) across ten counties returned Travis 394,928; DISTINCT ON (county_fips, feature_index) returned 828,773, matching count(DISTINCT feature_index) GROUP BY county_fips. The scorer itself is safe because it filters WHERE county_fips = $1 before the DISTINCT ON; any cross-county query is not.

rootCauseSummary: The zoning zeros are FOUR stacked causes, not one. (1) A silent table fallback converts 'the table I happened to read has no zoning column' into true-source-gap, a POSITIVE absence claim, at 0.00% - contract s5 / DEV_PROCESS 4.3. (2) Those rows then went stale for four weeks because nothing re-runs the scorer. (3) Even re-scored, the number is measured against all county parcels while only 23 of 1,222 Texas city zoning layers are wired, so no county can approach the 95% depth threshold and the depth gate correctly refuses to call it satisfied. (4) The one county that does display satisfied is satisfied on a number copied from its envelope facet. Written-and-served is real; scored-zero has an independent cause at every layer of the cell.

designDecisions.decision: Kill the silent fallback: when the resolved parcel table cannot carry zoning_district, the zoning and envelope facets are NOT MEASURABLE and the scorer refuses to write them, counting and printing the refusal. It must never write true-source-gap from a missing column.
designDecisions.why: true-source-gap is defined in the file's own header as 'the facet has no data because the SOURCE has none - an honest absence'. Deriving that from a schema accident is the exact defect class this programme hunts.

designDecisions.decision: Bound the claim by the instrument's own reach: a county with zero wired ZONING_LAYERS entries is not measurable for zoning/envelope by this instrument. Refuse the write; do not emit real-at-ceiling 0.00%.
designDecisions.why: real-at-ceiling asserts the achievable ceiling is reached. For 244 of 254 counties the instrument has no city layer at all, so it is measuring its own wiring, not the county.

designDecisions.decision: Make the counting rule travel with the number: write source as a self-describing basis, and populate verified_by_instrument / verification_method / artifact_path so a cell's author and denominator are readable at the point of use.
designDecisions.why: DEV_PROCESS 1.1/1.2. A 0.00% cell asserting satisfied-present with a NULL author survived four weeks precisely because nothing on the row said who wrote it or what it counted.

designDecisions.decision: One registry of facet keys (rail keys from COUNTY_RAIL_DECLARATION plus explicitly declared NON-RAIL diagnostic keys), a fail-closed assertion in the scorer, and a divergence test that also rejects near-miss collisions (hyphen/underscore/case-normalised) with any rail key.
designDecisions.why: DEV_PROCESS 2.4: one rule with two implementations is the CTRL-1 shape. 'land-use' vs 'landuse' is a near-miss no equality check would ever catch.

designDecisions.decision: Emit the CAD-roll join rate under the declared non-rail key 'landuse-cad-join'. Do NOT rename the 19 existing rows into 'landuse', do NOT alias at read time, do NOT delete them. Supply a dry-run-first reconcile that re-keys them to the diagnostic name and leave the apply for the operator.
designDecisions.why: V10 proves the two facets measure different subjects and a merge regresses 13 counties. Join quality was RULED not-a-rail on 2026-08-08 (_decisions/2026-08-08_county_shape_thirteen_rails_and_geometry_first.md, cited in countyRailDimension.ts). Deletions are operator rulings per DEV_PROCESS 5.4.

adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.candidate: Re-denominate zoning as stamped / parcels-with-a-zoning_jurisdiction (the 'in-jurisdiction' rate).
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.reason: It is a tautology. zoning_jurisdiction is written BY the same PIP that writes zoning_district, so in-jurisdiction coverage is 100.00% by construction. MEASURED: 48021 100.00, 48027 100.00, 48029 100.00, 48187 100.00, 48309 100.00, 48453 100.00 (276,168 stamped vs 276,163 in-jurisdiction; the 5-parcel excess is stamp residue predating migration 0062). Shipping 100% for Travis zoning would be strictly worse than the honest 33.32%.

adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.candidate: Re-denominate against incorporated-city parcels from tx_city_boundary.
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.verdict: CORRECT IN PRINCIPLE, OUT OF SCOPE FOR THIS LANE
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.reason: tx_city_boundary exists in this database (1,222 rows) but stores geometry as jsonb with only a bbox index, so the denominator needs a real point-in-polygon pass, and changing the zoning denominator moves the Texas launch-gate arithmetic. Named as the unblock and routed to the operator, not shipped here.

adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.candidate: Alias land-use to landuse at read time in manifestGridRead.
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.reason: The join is 1:1 on facet = rail_key. Aliasing makes two rows candidates for one cell with no rule for which wins, and the older, lower join-rate row would displace or race the newer atom-coverage row in 19 counties.

adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.candidate: Treat the 19-vs-1 depth gate as the third defect.
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.verdict: NOT A DEFECT IN ITS REFUSAL; DEFECTIVE IN WHAT IT ERASES
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.reason: V8 shows rail_state is written by nothing checked in, so a cell can assert satisfied-present at 0.00%. The gate is the only thing standing between that row and a customer-facing 'satisfied'. It is load-bearing safety. Its real defect is that it sets isPartial=false while demoting, so 'measured at 33.98% below a 95% bar' renders identically to 'never scored at all' - two classes collapsed into one display state, which is what made the zeros invisible for four weeks.

adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.candidate: Fix the missing schema filter in columnExists (information_schema.columns has no table_schema predicate while tableExists uses search_path-aware to_regclass).
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.verdict: REAL BUT NOT THE CAUSE HERE
adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign.reason: The asymmetry can only produce FALSE POSITIVES (a same-named table in another schema making the column look present). Only public and _system exist in this database and _system holds one Replit migration table, so it cannot explain hasZoning=false. Fixed anyway as a paired-control divergence, and explicitly NOT claimed as the root cause.

constraintsHonored: Read-only against production: every database statement so far is SELECT; the only CLI runs were --dry-run, whose code path skips upsertLedger.
Exit-bounded: every command terminated on its own; no watch, tail, or serve was started.
Heavy-scan serialization: parcel scans were run one at a time, longest 100.3s (48453 dry-run), 75s (ten-county stamp census). No concurrent heavy scan.
No sub-agents spawned (dispatch instruction; AGENT_CONTRACT s1 makes the fan optional, so this is a permitted narrowing, not a conflict).
